answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond with slashing. Each agent must lock a fixed stake, say 100 tokens, into the Atlas registry before it can earn, and provable cheating burns that stake. A sybil operator spinning up 1,000 fake agents must therefore post 1,000 separate 100-token bonds, 100,000 tokens total, all locked and at risk. Routing them through one funding inlet or staging them on a single cheap knoll node does not help: every identity still needs its own bond, so attack cost scales linearly with sybil count instead of being near-free.
